question: Does the entity have any project related to reducing GHG emission? If Yes, then provide details
answer: Yes, the company has a project related to reducing Green House Gas emission. To offset its Carbon Liabilities for FY2022-23, the Company retired 45 Verified Emission Reductions (VER) using the Gold Standards Certification Program. This was achieved through the 400 MW Solar Power Project at Bhadla, Rajasthan, India, which generates electricity using renewable solar energy. This project reduces anthropogenic emissions of greenhouse gases by an estimated ~694,471 tCO2e p.a. by replacing 732,874 MWh/year of electricity with renewable energy. The generated electricity is exported to the regional grid system, helping to diversify the mix of thermal/fossil-fuel based power plants connected to the national grid.
